name: db
description: Hasura for block on the shared Postgres (the db project): users and the blocks they keep. Port 5107, console 9775.

routines.create_db: varlock run --include-internal --filter APP_ENV,VAULT_ADDR,VAULT_TOKEN -- bash scripts/create-db.sh dev

panes.name: dev
panes.description: Hasura on :5107 (run routine dev_keep: it stays up after Ctrl-C), long-running

panes.name: console
panes.description: Hasura console on :9775 (run routine console); records migrations

panes.name: execution-shell
panes.description: ad-hoc commands, e.g. run routine migrate
